svg.title: Event-Contract Fee Load by Route
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-event-contract-fee-load-by-route; chapter number: 4; title: Event-Contract Fee Load by Route; subtitle: Cents per contract across ForecastEx, Kalshi via IBKR and settlement; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: 0 to 4 cents per contract depending on venue and exit path; buckets: label: Held to settlement; low: 0; high: 0; notes: Settlement is fee-free; contracts pay $1 or $0.; label: ForecastEx pairing fee; low: 0.5; high: 1; notes: Yes plus No pairs at $1.01, half a penny per side, with no other exchange, clearing, data or brokerage fees.; label: Kalshi via IBKR to settlement; low: 2; high: 2; notes: $0.01 IBKR plus $0.01 exchange per contract.; label: Kalshi via IBKR early exit; low: 4; high: 4; notes: Exiting early doubles the fees, turning a 48-cent exit into about 46 cents net.; caption: Binary contracts priced between roughly 1 and 99 cents read as probability; limit orders only, because thin books make market orders pay the wide spread on top of the fee.; assumptions note: Round-trip fee for an early exit is the doubled figure reported by TC Trading; spread costs in thin books were described but not quantified, so they are excluded.; note: Attributed to Interactive Brokers (ceR-weGZSXc), TC Trading (MREcV1sLqwc) and closeuptrading (4_swDdRFYJc).
